decisions.reason: The Hindi-only preview instruction does not change the required call-to-action content or establish that the closing message must appear in the preview shots.
The preview dialogue language and workflow do not change the audience age range or Indian target market.
The source does not change which product benefits or claims should be communicated or their source material.
Replacing immediate script delivery with preview shots does not change the established keyword choices or wording constraints; Hindi-only language is owned by the source Requirement.
The candidate's existing message-66 INTRODUCE already records the 10-second Hindi-only preview, its visual and dialogue content, and its approval purpose, so another MODIFY would be duplicative.
The preview-first instruction changes the immediate delivery workflow but does not alter the freelancer's full-service responsibility for footage, voiceover, and script.
The source does not change the required reference basis or the mode for adapting the reference creative.
The Hindi-only preview instruction does not modify the hook's strength, directness, viral style, timing, or market alignment.
Requiring Hindi dialogue in preview shots does not change the existing proper lip-sync standard.
The source specifies spoken dialogue language but does not mention or change subtitle content, language, or formatting.
The Hindi dialogue requirement does not resolve or change the required audio level or advertising mix standard.
The source does not change the required UGC color grading or final visual finish.
